verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Calendar Sync makes 'smart copies' of events from a source calendar onto a destination calendar. Those copies stay up to date as the source events change, so availability stays accurate across multiple calendars, including external ones such as iCloud synced into Google. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Calendar Sync, and explicit evidence of bidirectional work-to-personal syncing and of copies showing only as busy blocks.
